test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
As of 31st July 2025, which of the following country is the member of BIMSTEC?

I. Thailand

II. Iran
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only I**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **BIMSTEC** stands for **Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation**, comprising countries dependent on the Bay of Bengal for trade and economic cooperation.
 
• The member countries of BIMSTEC as of **31st July 2025** are **Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, and Thailand**.
 
• **Thailand** is one of the founding members of BIMSTEC, established on **6th June 1997**. Hence, **Statement I is correct.**
 
• **Iran** is not a member of BIMSTEC. It is geographically located outside the Bay of Bengal region and has no affiliation with BIMSTEC as of the given date. Hence, **Statement II is incorrect.**
 
• BIMSTEC primarily aims to foster cooperation in areas like trade, investment, energy, technology, and tourism among member countries in the Bay of Bengal region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **BIMSTEC Establishment:**

 
 
• BIMSTEC was established through the **Bangkok Declaration** on **6th June 1997** with initial members including Bangladesh, India, Sri Lanka, and Thailand.
 
• Later, Myanmar joined in **December 1997**, Nepal and Bhutan joined in **February 2004**.
 
 
 
• **Key Objectives of BIMSTEC:**
 
 
• To enhance regional cooperation among member countries in the Bay of Bengal region.
 
• To promote economic growth and sustainable development through mutual collaboration.
 
• To strengthen connectivity, trade, and investment among member nations.
 
 
 
• **Focus Areas of BIMSTEC Cooperation:**
 
 
• Major focus areas include **trade and investment, technology, energy, transportation and communication, tourism, fisheries, agriculture, public health, poverty alleviation**, and **climate change adaptation**.
 
• Special emphasis is laid on improving connectivity in the region via infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **Differences with SAARC:**
 
 
• BIMSTEC is seen as an alternative to **SAARC**, focusing exclusively on regional cooperation without political conflicts.
 
• Unlike SAARC, BIMSTEC excludes Pakistan, which makes it a preferred platform for India to strengthen regional ties.
 
 
 
• **Recent Developments:**
 
 
• The **5th BIMSTEC Summit** was held on **30th March 2022** in Colombo, Sri Lanka, where member countries agreed to enhance cooperation in various sectors.
 
• India emphasized the importance of **regional connectivity** and the implementation of the BIMSTEC Master Plan for Transport Connectivity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Member Countries:**

 
 
• India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, and Thailand.
 
• These countries represent a significant portion of the global population and economy in the Bay of Bengal region.
 
 
 
• **BIMSTEC Secretariat:**
 
 
• The BIMSTEC Secretariat is located in **Dhaka, Bangladesh**.
 
• It was established in **2014** to coordinate and monitor BIMSTEC activities.
 
 
 
• **Connectivity Projects:**
 
 
• Projects like the **Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Transport Project** aim to enhance connectivity between India and Myanmar.
 
• Efforts are underway to establish a **BIMSTEC Free Trade Area** (FTA) to boost trade and economic cooperation.
 
 
 
• **Future Agenda:**
 
 
• Strengthening institutional mechanisms and enhancing cooperation in priority sectors.
 
• Promoting people-to-people contact and cultural exchange among member nations.
